title: Real-Time Synthesis of Robust Controlled Invariant Sets for Monotone Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.14115v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety-critical control of autonomous systems requires formal safety certificates, such as controlled invariant sets, that must be computed online as conditions change. Although standard synthesis algorithms scale poorly with state dimension, monotone dynamical systems with lower-closed safety specifications allow for accelerated computation of controlled invariant sets. In particular, lazy fixed-point algorithms exploit monotonicity and track only the antichain basis of the set. However, membership tests and redundancy checks against an evolving basis remain major bottlenecks. We introduce a threshold-function reformulation in which a lower-closed set on a d-dimensional grid is represented by its column heights along a designated axis. translated_title: 单调系统的鲁棒控制不变集实时综合
translated_abstract: 自主系统的安全关键控制需要形式化的安全证书（例如控制不变集），且这些证书必须随条件变化在线计算。尽管标准综合算法随状态维度的增加扩展性较差，但具有下闭安全规范的单调动力系统可以实现控制不变集的加速计算。特别是，惰性不动点算法利用单调性，仅跟踪集合的反链基。然而，针对不断演化的基进行成员测试和冗余检查仍然是主要瓶颈。我们引入了一种阈值函数重构方法，将 d 维网格上的下闭集用其沿指定轴的列高来表示。这将最大不动点迭代重新表述为相互独立的一维二分搜索（每个网格列对应一次搜索），从而得到一种易于并行（embarrassingly parallel）的迭代方法，并具有渐近更低的计算……
tldr: 本文提出一种阈值函数重构方法，将单调系统控制不变集的最大不动点迭代转化为独立的每列一维二分搜索，实现高度并行的实时鲁棒控制不变集计算，并显著降低渐近计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a threshold-function reformulation that converts the greatest-fixed-point iteration for controlled invariant sets of monotone systems into independent one-dimensional binary searches per grid column, yielding an embarrassingly parallel algorithm with asymptotically lower computational cost for real-time robust safety synthesis.
